mapper.sql: AND COALESCE(o.order_time, o.source_created_at, o.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(o.order_time, o.source_created_at, o.create_time) < #{endDateExclusive}
mapper.select: SELECT o.source_type AS source_type, COUNT(1) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.rent_amount), 0) AS rent_amount_fen, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount_fen FROM rental_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.deleted = b'0' AND o.create_time >= #{startDate} AND o.create_time < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY o.source_type ORDER BY order_count DESC, o.source_type

SELECT o.shop_id, o.xgj_product_id, o.xianyu_item_id, o.xgj_sku_id, o.xianyu_sku_id, MAX(o.goods_title) AS goods_title, COUNT(1) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.goods_quantity), 0) AS goods_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS rent_amount_fen, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount_fen FROM xianyu_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.deleted = b'0'
GROUP BY o.shop_id, o.xgj_product_id, o.xianyu_item_id, o.xgj_sku_id, o.xianyu_sku_id ORDER BY rent_amount_fen DESC, order_count DESC, o.shop_id, o.xianyu_item_id, o.xgj_sku_id

SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.device_no, d.equipment_model_code, d.status, DATEDIFF( #{endDateExclusive}, GREATEST(#{startDate}, DATE(d.create_time)) ) AS total_days, COALESCE(s.occupied_days, 0) AS occupied_days, COALESCE(s.schedule_count, 0) AS schedule_count, COALESCE(i.assignment_count, 0) AS assignment_count, COALESCE(i.assigned_income_fen, 0) AS assigned_income_fen, COALESCE(i.latest_rental_order_id, s.latest_rental_order_id) AS latest_rental_order_id FROM rental_device d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rs.device_id, SUM(DATEDIFF( LEAST(rs.occupy_end_date_exclusive, #{endDateExclusive}), GREATEST(rs.occupy_start_date, #{startDate}) )) AS occupied_days, COUNT(1) AS schedule_count, MAX(rs.rental_order_id) AS latest_rental_order_id FROM rental_schedule rs WHERE rs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rs.deleted = b'0' AND rs.status = 'EFFECTIVE' AND rs.occupy_start_date < #{endDateExclusive} AND rs.occupy_end_date_exclusive > #{startDate} GROUP BY rs.device_id ) s ON s.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.device_id, COUNT(1) AS assignment_count, SUM( (oi.rent_amount DIV ac.assignment_count) + IF(a.id = ac.remainder_assignment_id, MOD(oi.rent_amount, ac.assignment_count), 0) ) AS assigned_income_fen, MAX(a.rental_order_id) AS latest_rental_order_id FROM rental_device_assignment a INNER JOIN rental_order_item oi ON oi.id = a.rental_order_item_id AND oi.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND oi.deleted = b'0' INNER JOIN ( SELECT rental_order_item_id, COUNT(1) AS assignment_count, MIN(id) AS remainder_assignment_id FROM rental_device_assignment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND status = 'ASSIGNED' GROUP BY rental_order_item_id ) ac ON ac.rental_order_item_id = a.rental_order_item_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = b'0' AND a.status = 'ASSIGNED' AND oi.billable_start_date >= #{startDate} AND oi.billable_start_date < #{endDateExclusive} GROUP BY a.device_id ) i ON i.device_id = d.id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0' AND DATE(d.create_time) < #{endDateExclusive} ORDER BY assigned_income_fen DESC, occupied_days DESC, d.id

SELECT COUNT(1) AS ship_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS ship_amount_fen, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount_fen FROM xianyu_order o WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.deleted = b'0' AND o.ship_date = #{date}
